text: Da Nang summit explores AI agents to drive business growth and automation
The CEOxAI Summit 2026 opened in central Da Nang city on October 28, focusing on how digital technology and AI agents can help businesses build autonomous operations and accelerate growth.
As the Fourth Industrial Revolution continues to reshape the economy, artificial intelligence is emerging as a key driver of digital economic development.

AI is being increasingly adopted across manufacturing, business operations, management and service delivery, helping streamline processes, improve labour productivity and introduce new operating models.
Beyond being a technology trend, AI offers businesses opportunities to enhance productivity, optimise management processes, improve service quality and innovate their business models.
The development of AI agents, in particular, is providing new tools to carry out tasks, process information and automate multiple stages of business workflows.

At the summit, participants explored a range of topics through presentations, including the current state of AI adoption among small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), how AI agents are transforming business operations, and how to design business operating systems based on data, processes and AI.
The event also provided a platform for business leaders, experts and technology solution providers to exchange experiences and discuss practical challenges in implementing AI.

Presentations and in-depth discussions helped participants identify potential applications in accounting, human resources, sales and management, while considering approaches suited to their operational needs and resources.
As Da Nang advances its digital transformation, wider adoption of AI and AI agents could strengthen business competitiveness and create new growth opportunities for the city's digital economy.

The initiative also aims to foster closer links among local government agencies, businesses and technology providers, supporting an innovation ecosystem focused on higher productivity and sustainable economic growth.
